input_dir.description: Source directory to scan for PDFs.

output_dir.description: Destination directory for processed PDFs (ignored; outputs go to OCR subfolders).

include_glob.description: Glob pattern(s) to include, relative to input_dir.

exclude_glob.description: Glob pattern(s) to exclude, relative to input_dir (excludes OCR output folders).

exclude_output_dir.description: Skip output_dir when it is under input_dir to avoid reprocessing output.

sort_by.description: Sort order for inputs: none, path, mtime, size.

max_files.description: Limit number of files processed (0 = no limit).

print_every.description: Print progress every N files (1 = every file, 0 = errors only).

skip_big_mb.description: Skip files larger than this size in MB.

dup_threshold.description: Duplicate-line ratio threshold for auto redo.

text_sample_pages.description: Pages to sample when detecting existing text.

force_ocr_all.description: Force OCR even if a text layer exists.

in_place.description: Process and replace PDFs in place.

preserve_fstimes.description: Preserve output file times from: xmp, fs, none.

timeout.description: Per-file timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

tesseract_time.description: Tesseract timeout per page in seconds (0 = no timeout).

resume_from_csv.description: Skip files already listed in the CSV report.

csv_append.description: Append to existing CSV instead of overwriting.
